title: BlueBlocks: Block Explorer Web Application
description:
Create web-based block explorer for BlueBlocks testnet/devnet.

## Technology Stack
- Framework: Next.js 14 (React)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- State: TanStack Query + Zustand
- Charts: Recharts

## Features
- Real-time block updates via WebSocket/SSE
- Network statistics dashboard
- Transaction search and details
- Account balance viewer
- Validator status and leaderboard
- Contract inspection
- Faucet interface for test tokens

## Pages
- / - Dashboard with stats, latest blocks/txs
- /blocks - Block list and details
- /transactions - Transaction list and details
- /validators - Validator list and status
- /contracts - Contract explorer
- /faucet - Request test tokens
